verdict.rationale: FireHydrant publishes an official MCP server for its API, so an AI assistant can drive the product from natural-language requests. Its other AI features (summaries, Copilot suggestions, Draft with AI) generate content rather than accept commands, and Slack `/fh` is a structured slash command, not natural language. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface, documentation of which actions the MCP server exposes, and hands-on corroboration that NL operation works.
